Skills.Name: Normal Attack: Shadow-Stealing Spirit Vessel
Skills.Desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Calls upon secret arts passed down through the Masters of the Night-Wind from generation to generation, performing up to three strikes that deal <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Enters Aiming Mode, and after Holding, consumes a certain amount of Stamina to call forth a Frost Star that deals <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> to opponents in its path.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals <color=#99FFFFFF>Aoe Cryo DMG</color>upon impact with the ground.

Skills.Name: Dawnfrost Darkstar
Skills.Desc: Invoking secret pacts passed down by her tribe over the millennia, Citlali deploys an Opal Shield and calls forth "Obsidian Tzitzimitl: Itzpapa," a creature that is (reputedly) terrifying beyond compare, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Cryo DMG. The Opal Shield's DMG absorption scales based on Citlali's Elemental Mastery, and absorbs Cryo DMG with 250% efficiency. After using this skill, Citlali gains 24 Nightsoul points and enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state. Nightsoul's Blessing: Citlali When Itzpapa leaves the field, Citlali exits the Nightsoul's Blessing state. Itzpapa ·Itzpapa will follow the character. ·If Citlali has at least 50 Nightsoul points, Itzpapa enters the Opal Fire state and continuously consumes Nightsoul points to whip up a Frostfall Storm that attacks opponents within its AoE, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Cryo DMG. ·When Citlali's Nightsoul points are fully depleted, Itzpapa's Opal Fire state also ends. Usually, the wills that symbolize different stars cannot coexist, for how can purest black be reflected in purest white? Be that as it may, Citlali has never harbored a particular preference for colors themselves, and that is just how things played out in the end.

Skills.Name: Edict of Entwined Splendor
Skills.Desc: Summons forth "allies" from the starry skies and the vast earth, hurling an icy storm to bombard the area in front that deals Nightsoul-aligned AoE Cryo DMG, restores a fixed amount of Nightsoul points to Citlali, and also summons 1 Spiritvessel Skull near a maximum of 3 opponents within the AoE. Spiritvessel Skulls explode after a period of time, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Cryo DMG and restoring a fixed amount of Nightsoul points to Citlali.\n\n"Ugh, enough of this 'dark star, opal star' stuff! Citlalin, Itzpapa, get 'em!"

Passives.Name: Mamaloaco's Frigid Rain
Passives.Desc: When Citlali is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, after nearby party members trigger the Frozen or Melt reactions, the <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color> and <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color> RES of opponents affected by that reaction decreases by 20% for 12s. Additionally, Citlali will regain 16 Nightsoul points. Nightsoul points can be restored this way once every 8s.

Passives.Name: Itzpapalotl's Star Garments
Passives.Desc: During the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Dawnfrost Darkstar</color>, Itzpapa's Frostfall Storm DMG is increased by 90% of Citlali's Elemental Mastery. During the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Edict of Entwined Splendor</color>, Ice Storm DMG is increased by 2400% of Citlali's Elemental Mastery.\nIn addition, when nearby party members trigger Nightsoul Bursts, Citlali regains 4 Nightsoul points.

Passives.Name: Night Realm's Gift: Smoke, Mirrors, and the Flowing Winds
Passives.Desc:
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, can use Nightsoul Transmission: Citlali. When the active character is currently high enough in the air, the following will trigger when switching to Citlali: Citlali will leap up high, and will deploy "White Obsidian Tzitzimitl: Citlalin" to float in the air. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your party.

Holding Aiming Mode will cause Citlali to enter the "Spiritspeaker" state, which will allow her to interact with "Nightspirit Graffiti" and "Nightspirit Sigils," extracting information and power from them. The rules for interacting with these objects follow the same rules as those governing Iktomisaurus interactions.

Additionally, holding the jump button will cause Citlali to consume 75 Stamina and leap. In areas within Natlan where Phlogiston mechanics are present, Citlali will prioritize consuming 5 Phlogiston to leap to a height higher still.
When in the air, Citlali can Hold her Normal Attack to consume Phlogiston or Stamina and enter Aiming Mode and trigger Charged Attacks: When initiating Charged Attacks in mid-air, Citlali will prioritize consuming 20 Phlogiston.

Passives.Name: Life Talent
Passives.Desc: When Nightsoul Burst is triggered, restore 20 Phlogiston to the party. This cannot take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.

Constellations.Name: Bladed Light of Four Hundred Stars
Constellations.Desc:
When she uses the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Dawnfrost Darkstar</color>, Citlali gains the "Opalstar Vestments" effect until her Nightsoul's Blessing state ends. During this time, she will obtain 10 Stellar Blades. When a nearby active character other than Citlali deals DMG, consume 1 Blade to increase the DMG dealt by 200% of Citlali's Elemental Mastery.
After nearby party members trigger Frozen or Melt, Citlali will gain another 3 Stellar Blades. This effect can trigger once every 8s.

Using the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Dawnfrost Darkstar</color> will reset Stellar Blade stacks.
Additionally, when Citlali is using her leap, or is Aiming or using her Charged Attack in mid-air, her Phlogiston consumption is decreased by 45%.

Constellations.Name: Death Defier's Spirit Skull
Constellations.Desc:
Citlali gains 125 Elemental Mastery, and other characters shielded by her Opal Shield gain 250 Elemental Mastery.
Additionally, when the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Dawnfrost Darkstar</color> is used, nearby active characters will also be granted an Opal Shield.

Also, the Passive Talent "Mamaloaco's Frigid Rain" has its effects enhanced:
When Citlali is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, after nearby party members trigger Frozen or Melt, the opponent(s) affected by this reaction will have their <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color> and <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color> RES additionally decreased by 20% for 12s. You must first unlock the Passive Talent "Mamaloaco's Frigid Rain" to gain access to the above effect.

Constellations.Name: Cloud Serpent's Feathered Crown
Constellations.Desc: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Dawnfrost Darkstar</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.

Constellations.Name: Heart Devourer's Travail
Constellations.Desc: While the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Dawnfrost Darkstar</color> is active, when Itzpapa's Frostfall Storm hits opponents, an additional <color=#FFD780FF>Obsidian Spiritvessel Skull</color> is summoned. When a Spiritvessel Skull summoned this way explodes, it deals 1200% of Citlali's Elemental Mastery as Nightsoul-aligned <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> and restores 16 Nightsoul points to Citlali. This effect can trigger once every 8s. This DMG is not considered Elemental Burst DMG.

Constellations.Name: Curse of the Five Blighted Days
Constellations.Desc: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Edict of Entwined Splendor</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.

Constellations.Name: Secret Pact of Wisdom
Constellations.Desc: The Itzpapa summoned by Elemental Skill <color=E586>Dawnfrost Darkstar</color> will always be in the Opal Fire state, and when Nightsoul points are exhausted, this state will not end.\nAdditionally, <color=#FFD780FF>Dawnfrost Darkstar</color> is used, Itzpapa will consume all Nightsoul points, and while it is on the field, it will continuously consume Nightsoul points to grant all nearby party members <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>, <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>, and <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> DMG Bonuses, with each consumed Nightsoul point granting 1.5% of the corresponding DMG Bonus. The maximum DMG Bonus that can be gained this way is 60%.
